title: Font-load fallback branch (GetFontDefault) has zero coverage — the spec's declared error path is never exercised
detail: Spec's error row ("fall back to GetFontDefault … IsFontValid check") has zero coverage: no test or capture exercises IsFontValid=false; harness.sh always cds to root, so verification only takes the happy branch.
recommended_fix: Add an app/render unit test: load_hud_font against a bogus path must return the raylib default font (and log), pinning the fallback branch the spec's edge-case matrix declares.
